cancelOrder.description: The `cancelOrder` function calls the [`cancelOrder`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/cancel-order/) mutation. You must pass an order ID and reason.

orderId.description: The ID of the order to cancel.

reason.description: The reason for canceling the order.

onSuccess.description: The callback function to execute when the order is successfully canceled.

onError.description: The callback function to execute when an error occurs.

confirmCancelOrder.description: The `confirmCancelOrder` function confirms the cancellation of an order using the provided order ID and confirmation key. The function calls the [`confirmCancelOrder`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/confirm-cancel-order/) mutation.
confirmCancelOrder.events: Emits the `order/data` event with the updated order information after confirming the cancellation.

orderId.description: The ID of the order to cancel.

confirmationKey.description: A key generated when a guest requests to cancel an order.

getAttributesList.description: The `getAttributesList` function is a wrapper for the [`attributesList`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/attributes/queries/attributes-list/) query. You must pass an attribute code to retrieve the list. The system default values are `CUSTOMER`, `CUSTOMER_ADDRESS`, `CATALOG_PRODUCT` and `RMA_ITEM`.

entityType.description: The entity type for which to retrieve the list of attributes.

getCustomer.description: The `getCustomer` function is a wrapper for the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query. You must pass a customer ID to retrieve the customer data.

getCustomerOrdersReturn.description: The `getCustomerOrdersReturn` function returns details about the returns a customer has requested. It is a wrapper for the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query.

pageSize.description: The number of orders to return at a time.

getGuestOrder.description: The `getGuestOrder` function is a wrapper for the [`guestOrder`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/queries/guest-order/) query.

email.description: The email address associated with the order.

lastname.description: The last name associated with the order.

getOrderDetailsById.description: The `getOrderDetailsById` function is a wrapper for the [`customer`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/customer/queries/customer/) query. You must pass an order ID to retrieve the order details.

orderId.description: The ID of the order to retrieve.

queryType.description: The type of query to perform. Use orderData as the value

returnsPageSize.description: The number of returns to return at a time.

getStoreConfig.description: The `getStoreConfig` function returns information about the storefront configuration. It is a wrapper for the [`storeConfig`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/store/queries/store-config/) query.

guestOrderByToken.description: The `guestOrderByToken` function retrieves a guest order using a token generated by Adobe Commerce. It is a wrapper for the `guestOrderByToken` query. The function calls the [`guestOrderByToken`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/queries/guest-order-by-token/) query.

token.description: A token for the order assigned by Adobe Commerce.

reorderItems.description: The `reorderItems` function allows a logged-in customer to add all the products from a previous order into their cart. It is a wrapper for the [`reorderItems`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/reorder-items/) mutation.

requestGuestOrderCancel.description:
The `requestGuestOrderCancel` function is similar to the `cancelOrder` function, but it is used for guest orders.
The token is a unique value generated using guest's email, order number and postcode The function calls the [`requestGuestOrderCancel`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/request-guest-order-cancel/) mutation.

token.description: The token for the order assigned by Adobe Commerce.

reason.description: The reason for canceling the order.

onSuccess.description: The callback function to execute when the order is successfully canceled.

onError.description: The callback function to execute when an error occurs.

requestReturn.description: The `requestReturn` function takes the `RequestReturnProps` form as an argument and initiates the process of returning items from an order. It is a wrapper for the [`requestReturn`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/request-return/) mutation.

form.description: The form data for the return request.

placeNegotiableQuoteOrder.description: The `placeNegotiableQuoteOrder` function places an order for a negotiable quote. It is a wrapper for the `placeNegotiableQuoteOrder` mutation. The function calls the [`placeNegotiableQuoteOrder`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/place-negotiable-quote-order/) mutation.

quoteUid.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the negotiable quote to place as an order.

confirmGuestReturn.description: The `confirmGuestReturn` function confirms a return request for a guest order using an order ID and confirmation key. The function calls the [`confirmReturn`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/confirm-return/) mutation.

orderId.description: The ID of the order for which the return is being confirmed.

confirmationKey.description: The confirmation key sent to the guest's email address to authorize the return.

requestGuestReturn.description: The `requestGuestReturn` function initiates a return request for a guest order. The function calls the [`requestGuestReturn`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/orders/mutations/request-guest-return/) mutation.

form.description: The form data for the guest return request, including order details and items to return.

setPaymentMethodAndPlaceOrder.description: The `setPaymentMethodAndPlaceOrder` function sets the payment method on a cart and immediately places the order. The function calls the [`setPaymentMethodOnCart`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/cart/mutations/set-payment-method-on-cart/) mutation.

cartId.description: The ID of the cart to place as an order.

paymentMethod.description: The payment method information to apply to the cart before placing the order.
